operating_notes.text: India Ratings withdrew ratings on ₹195 Cr bank facilities following receipt of No Dues Certificates and zero outstanding bank exposure.
Installed capacity of Acetonitrile (ACN) Plant enhanced to 1,440 TPM at Unit-III Solapur from 24 September 2026.
DGFT Pune placed license 3111001781 on Denied Entity List on 13 August 2024 for export obligation violation; disclosed after SEBI query on 29 Sep 2026.
SEBI issued Warning cum Advisory Letter citing non-disclosure of DGFT Denied Entity List order (13 Aug 2024) and FDA Maharashtra strict warning on Propylene Glycol quality (10 Jan 2025).

timeline.summary: Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹455.93 Cr (+27.2% YoY), net profit ₹78.12 Cr (+113.9% YoY).
India Ratings withdrew its ratings on ₹195 Cr bank facilities after Balaji Amines cleared all bank exposures.
Commenced commercial production at enhanced Acetonitrile plant in Solapur, taking installed capacity to 1,440 TPM.
Disclosed DGFT order dated August 2024 placing export license 3111001781 on Denied Entity List following SEBI directive.
SEBI issued a Warning-cum-Advisory letter on 29 September 2026 to Balaji Amines over undisclosed DGFT and FDA Maharashtra regulatory actions.
